proof_summary: Modular exponentiation and gcd computations show that \(28341\) has exact multiplicative order \(28341\) modulo \(283411^2\): its \(28341\)-st power is \(1\), while \(28341^d-1\) is a unit for every proper divisor \(d\mid 28341\). Evaluating \(x^{28341}-1=\prod_{d\mid 28341}\Phi_d(x)\) at \(x=28341\), the proper-divisor cyclotomic factors are units, so the remaining factor must vanish modulo \(283411^2\).
